name: Revenue
definition: Revenue as reported (IFRS 15). Company-specific top-line definitions are documented on the company sheet.

name: Gross profit
definition: Revenue less cost of sales, as reported.

name: Operating income
definition: Operating profit as reported (before finance costs, zakat and tax).

name: Depreciation, amortisation & impairment
definition: From the cash-flow statement reconciliation.

name: EBITDA (company-reported)
definition: As disclosed by the company with its own definition; shown for reference only.

name: EBITDA (calculated)
definition: Operating income + depreciation, amortisation & impairment (C).

name: Net profit attributable to shareholders
definition: Net income attributable to equity holders of the parent, after zakat and tax.

name: Underlying net profit attributable
definition: NI_ATTR less material one-offs identified in the Adjustments register (C).

name: Operating cash flow
definition: Net cash from operating activities.

name: Capital expenditure
definition: Purchases of property, plant & equipment and intangibles (cash-flow statement).

name: Free cash flow
definition: Operating cash flow less capex (C).

name: Net debt
definition: Borrowings incl. lease liabilities less cash and short-term deposits, as reported or calculated (C).

name: Gross margin
definition: Gross profit / revenue.

name: EBITDA margin (calculated)
definition: EBITDA (calculated) / revenue.

name: Operating margin
definition: Operating income / revenue (Banks: / TOI).

name: Net margin
definition: Attributable net profit / revenue (Banks: / TOI).

name: Total operating income
definition: As reported; components checked to sum.

name: Net special commission / financing income
definition: Special commission income less expense; Islamic banks' 'net income from financing and investments' mapped here and flagged.

name: Net fee & commission income
definition: As reported.

name: Other operating income
definition: TOI less NSCI less fees (FX, trading, investment, dividend, other) (C).

name: Operating expenses before impairment
definition: Total operating expenses excluding ECL and other impairment charges (C where filing includes impairments).

name: Impairment charges (net)
definition: Net ECL and other impairment charges, total.

name: Impairment charge on financing
definition: Net expected-credit-loss charge on loans/financing (net of recoveries). The income-statement basis differs by bank (some include other financial assets or real-estate items), so cross-bank comparison is approximate; each bank's basis is listed in the Banks sector data notes.

name: Pre-provision operating profit
definition: TOI less pre-impairment operating expenses (C).

name: Cost-to-income ratio
definition: Pre-impairment operating expenses / TOI.

name: Total assets
definition: Period-end.

name: Net financing (loans & advances)
definition: Period-end, net of ECL allowance.

name: Customer deposits
definition: Period-end.

name: Equity attributable to equity holders
definition: Period-end, including Tier 1 sukuk.

name: Tier 1 sukuk
definition: Period-end carrying amount of Additional Tier 1 sukuk classified in equity.

name: Tier 1 sukuk distributions
definition: Distributions on Tier 1 sukuk charged to equity in the period.

name: Return on ordinary equity (calculated)
definition: (NI_ATTR - T1_COST) / average (EQ_ATTR - T1_SUKUK); YTD annualised x12/months.

name: ROE (company definition)
definition: As disclosed by the bank; definitions differ; reference only.

name: Cost of risk
definition: IMPAIR_FIN / average LOANS; YTD annualised. Shown in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). Approximately comparable across banks: see the IMPAIR_FIN basis note.

name: NSCI margin on average assets (proxy)
definition: NSCI / average total assets; YTD annualised.

name: Loan-to-deposit ratio
definition: Net financing / customer deposits (period-end).

name: Hydrocarbon production
definition: Company-disclosed total hydrocarbon production.

name: Crude oil production
definition: Company-disclosed.

name: Average realised crude price
definition: Company-disclosed.

name: Rig fleet
definition: Owned/operated rigs at period end, as disclosed.

name: Fleet utilisation
definition: As disclosed; definition noted per company.

name: Contract backlog
definition: As disclosed.

name: Vessel fleet
definition: By segment where disclosed.

name: Fuel stations
definition: Period-end network, as disclosed.

name: Volumes sold
definition: Litres / barrels / tonnes as disclosed.

name: Other income related to sales (Aramco)
definition: Government compensation for revenue forgone on regulated domestic prices (Aramco only); shown separately, not in sector revenue.

name: Revenue incl. other income related to sales (Aramco)
definition: Aramco's own top line: revenue + other income related to sales (C).

name: Operating profit (as reported)
definition: Operating profit line as printed (function-of-expense statements).

name: Profit before zakat and income tax
definition: As reported.

name: Depreciation, amortisation (and impairment where combined), cash-flow
definition: Sum of depreciation/amortisation add-backs in the cash-flow reconciliation.

name: Impairment add-backs (cash-flow)
definition: Impairment add-backs in the cash-flow reconciliation.

name: Net fee & commission income
definition: Fee lines at the top fee level of the income statement summed (gross fee income + fee expense where both shown) (C where summed).

name: Total impairment charges (net)
definition: Impairment / provision / credit-loss lines inside total operating expenses.

name: Ordinary shareholders' equity
definition: Equity attributable to equity holders less Tier 1 sukuk (C).

name: Return on equity
definition: Banks: (NI_ATTR - T1_COST) / avg EQ_ORD; Energy: NI_ATTR / avg EQ_ATTR. YTD annualised x12/9.

name: Return on average assets
definition: NI_ATTR / average total assets; YTD annualised.

name: Fee share of income
definition: Net fees / TOI.

name: Capex intensity
definition: Capex / revenue.

name: Revenue incl. other income related to sales (margin base)
definition: Revenue plus other income related to sales (Aramco's government compensation for regulated domestic prices). Equal to revenue for every company except Aramco. Used as the denominator of Energy margins because that income sits inside operating income, EBITDA and profit (C).

name: EBITDA excl. identified one-offs
definition: Calculated EBITDA less material one-off gains (or plus one-off losses) listed in the one-offs register with their source page (C).

name: EBITDA margin excl. identified one-offs
definition: EBITDA excl. identified one-offs / margin base (REV_M).

name: Other operating income
definition: Total operating income less net special commission (financing) income and net fee and commission income: FX, trading, investment, dividend and other income (C).

name: Net profit for the period (incl. non-controlling interests)
definition: Profit for the period after zakat and tax, before allocation to non-controlling interests.

name: Total equity (incl. non-controlling interests)
definition: Total equity as reported, including non-controlling interests and (banks) Tier 1 sukuk.

name: Special commission expense / return on deposits
definition: Gross special commission (or financing) expense paid on deposits and borrowings; supporting line for the margin analysis.

name: Gross special commission / financing income
definition: Gross special commission (or financing and investment) income before the expense on deposits; supporting line for the margin analysis.

name: Zakat and income tax
definition: Zakat plus income tax charged in the income statement (continuing operations).

name: Share of results of joint ventures and associates
definition: Equity-accounted share of profit or loss of joint ventures and associates.
